# Dimitris Kotlidas

> White label performance marketing for agencies. I run Meta Ads, Google Ads and tracking under your agency's brand. €3M+ in ad spend managed per year, up to 11.93x ROAS. Based in Strasbourg, France, working in UK and EU time zones.

Dimitris Kotlidas works with web development, SEO, branding and design agencies that have no in-house performance marketing team. The agency sells the service and owns the client relationship. Dimitris builds and manages the campaigns, tracking and reporting under the agency's brand, under a non-compete agreement.

Services: Meta and social ads, Google Ads, Google Tag Manager setup, server-side tracking and Meta CAPI, paid media strategy, creative briefs. Also consulting and GTM training for agencies that want to build the skill in-house.

How it works: audit, competitor research, website audit, strategy, media plan and budget, execution (setup in 3 to 5 days), weekly optimisation and monthly reporting in the agency's template. Month to month, no minimum term.

Good fit: client accounts with a real offer, such as e-commerce spending €3K+/month on ads or lead gen that needs qualified pipeline. Not a fit: client accounts under €500/month in ad spend.

Contact: book a free 15 minute call at https://dkotlidas.com/#contact
